about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I enjoy understanding problems and turning them into useful software. I take an organized, methodical approach: clarify what is needed, plan the work, and build a solution that makes sense for the people using it.
about.paragraph2: I study Software Engineering at UPC (eighth semester), with a strong academic record, and work as a consultant at 180 Degrees Consulting UPC. I combine my technical education with an interest in understanding the needs of people and organizations.
about.paragraph3: I work as a freelance Full Stack developer and have five months of backend experience at Devdatep Consulting, where I worked with APIs, databases, and integrations for EmiteFacil. I enjoy collaborating, taking responsibility, and learning through each project.

internship.product_summary: I worked on the backend of this electronic invoicing SaaS platform, connecting its services, data, and validation processes.
internship.bullet1: I developed REST APIs with Laravel 11 and PHP 8.2, using a service-oriented architecture and the Repository and DTO patterns.
internship.bullet2: I integrated digital signatures and SOAP/XML communication with SUNAT for EmiteFacil’s electronic invoicing.
internship.bullet3: I automated RUC and DNI validation through queries to government APIs.
internship.bullet4: I implemented authentication and sessions with Laravel Sanctum and contributed to relational database design in MySQL.
